config.purpose: Scalar block-0 q-projection with fixed-point requantization on RV64IMC.
notes: The model is a matching recovered reference; the C test consumes frozen headers.
Spike instruction counts are distinct from CV-Wally hardware cycles.
The Q39 rule is verified for case 0, not claimed bit-exact for all possible accumulators.
